considerations: Review the parent process, account and working path.
Confirm whether the activity was approved. GSocket is dual-use.
Review network events separately. Process execution alone cannot establish a relay session.
description: Find GSocket tooling in Linux endpoint process telemetry for review.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed GSocket and gs-netcat process activity on compromised Linux hosts, sometimes with renamed binaries.
evidence.location: Advanced hunting queries and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Known GSocket executable names or command-line references may identify investigated relay tooling.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: GSocket Process Activity

1.json:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ ("gs-netcat", "gsocket", "gsnetcat")
     or ProcessCommandLine contains "gs-netcat"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
